ai_provisions: Whole declaration — ten measures on responsible development, deployment and use of military AI and autonomy
relevance.excluded_scope: Non-binding political declaration; no verification, enforcement or legal obligation; not all States endorse it.
relevance.reason: The principal political declaration on responsible military use of AI and autonomy. It sets out non-legally binding measures for States across the lifecycle of military AI capabilities, including human command and control and compliance with international humanitarian law. It is not a treaty.
